assertion.constants: Keep each stated constant and its original dependencies; numerical finite-artifact bounds are not recomputed by this coverage table.
assertion.normalizations: Keep the source normalizations of maps, coefficient fields, signs, lattices and measures appearing in the compound assertion.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Retain all exceptional cases and qualifications in the compound assertion and source; no historical rejection is promoted.
assertion.limit_order: Retain the source order of choices, limits and specializations exactly; an unchanged passage is not evidence for an altered incoming supplier.

source_derived_assertions.reason: Source-derived requirement; supplier identity will be reconciled only after this initial table is frozen.

scope: Author contract; checked means author checked. Pending non-author acceptance and upstream binding. No independent acceptance inferred.
